messages:
Sam (CSM): Hi team — kicking off Veridex onboarding. Quick goals for first 30 days: API integration + SSO, p95 latency < 300ms on core retrieval, intent pass >= 90% on their labeled set, and a weekly pilot feedback pulse. Who's owning what on Veridex?
Nadia (Veridex PM): Nadia here. I'll own product acceptance and will provide the labeled validation set. Key product targets: intent accuracy >= 0.9 and search MRR uplift >= 0.1.
Theo (Veridex Infra): Theo (infra). Our IdP OIDC metadata: https://sso.veridex.co/. We'll need Redwood outbound IPs and a short DNS window for cutover. Preferred weekend window: Sat 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Jules (Solutions Eng): Jules — I'll lead the connector + bench. Proposed plan: wk1 connector+SSO smoke, wk2 e2e bench + relevance tuning, wk3 acceptance + enablement. Please share the labeled prompts by day 7.
Sam (CSM): I'll schedule three workshops (tech deep-dive, prompts lab, support playbook) and set up a 5-question weekly Typeform for pilot users. Tentative dates next Tue/Thu.
ProvisionBot: sandbox provisioned: veridex-pilot-sbx v1.0 at 4567891290 (creds sent via secure email)
Jules (Solutions Eng): Got the sandbox. Quick q: start with prefix/KV caching ON or OFF? My suggestion: OFF for the first 10 days to avoid masking regressions, then enable in canary.
Nadia (Veridex PM): Agree — caching OFF initially. Also request per-route cost tags in logs so we can attribute spend to Search vs Assistant.
Theo (Veridex Infra): We'll need the exact IPs to allowlist. Potential windows: Sat 02:00-03:00 UTC ok. Also want a short rollback plan in case of auth issues.
Sam (CSM): Action items: 1) Jules -> upload curl examples, sandbox creds, and bench script; 2) Nadia -> deliver labeled eval set + acceptance doc; 3) Theo -> confirm OIDC metadata + pick maintenance window; 4) Sam -> send allowlist template + Typeform link and create shared acceptance doc. Renewal flag: if active pilot traffic < 25% of target by day 21 we'll trigger AM escalation.
Jules (Solutions Eng): Adding a quick curl example to the shared doc:
```
curl -X POST https://sbx.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VERIDEX_SBX" \\\
  -d '{"input":"Extract invoice total for #789"}'
```
Nadia (Veridex PM): We'll aim to deliver 120 labeled examples by EOD Fri. Please record enablement sessions and drop them in our Confluence.
Theo (Veridex Infra): Confirmed we'll open egress for the provided IPs once you post them. Maintenance window locked to Sat 02:00-03:00 UTC. OIDC metadata link posted in the shared doc.
Sam (CSM): Noted. Also setting up a short daily check-in note in this thread for the first 14 days. I'll circulate invites + the Typeform and post the acceptance-criteria doc here after this thread. :thumbsup: 
Jules (Solutions Eng): I'll also include a small latency probe script and show how to enable route-level tags. Small probe: 
```
for i in {1..30}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $VERIDEX_SBX" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://sbx.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate >/dev/null; done
```
Nadia (Veridex PM): Thanks all — looking forward. One more ask: can we start with a conservative token quota on the sandbox to avoid runaway costs?
Jules (Solutions Eng): Yep, I'll set a 50k-token cap for the sandbox and raise after acceptance.
Sam (CSM): Great. Check-in scheduled for day7 bench results. I'll post the shared doc link here shortly.
